_note: What you see: The academy's workspace tokens on Cunningham: colours, status pills with their contrast, shapes and the choice not to use decided next to received.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: De werkplek-tokens van de academie op Cunningham: kleuren, statuspillen met hun contrast, vormen en de keuze om besloten niet naast ontvangen te gebruiken.
Planning, trainers en administratie werk: Planning, trainers and administration work in Nextcloud with the Cunningham components of La Suite and the academy's tokens. Light and calm. Petrol is an action, glow is your place in the menu and what comes first, red is late.
Zachte vlakken met donkere tekst. Elke t: Soft surfaces with dark text. Every text reaches at least 4.5 : 1. The seven pills are the same in all four education themes.
Ontvangen en besloten delen hier hetzelf: Received and decided share the same surface here, because light petrol equals #E3F1F3. That is why the academy does not use "decided" next to "received": confirmed is green.
Knoppen 8, kaarten 12: de schaal van Nex: Buttons 8, cards 12: the Nextcloud scale, so built-in apps take the colours too. The website keeps its own, squarer corners of 3 and 6. Shadow only on cards: 0 1px 2px, 4% ink.
De kaart die zegt wat eerst moet: The card that says what comes first
Vlak in gloed licht, label in gloed donk: Surface in light glow, label in dark glow. No coloured border on the left. One per screen, with one petrol button.
Is iets te laat, dan staat dat er in roo: If something is late, it says so in red, with words and an icon. Glow alone is never a warning.
Focus: 2 px petrol rand, altijd zichtbaa: Focus: 2 px petrol border, always visible.
Actief: gloed donker op gloed licht: Active: dark glow on light glow
De teller is gloed met witte tekst, 5,2: The counter is glow with white text, 5.2 : 1.
Tekst 15 in Barlow, de standaard van Nex: Text 15 in Barlow, the Nextcloud default
